{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import numpy as np
from modules.ann_surrogate import get_surrogate_engine

engine = get_surrogate_engine()
assert len(engine.models) >= 13, f'Expected >=13 models, found {len(engine.models)}'

for name, cfg in engine.models.items():
    test_in = cfg.input_norm.xoffset
    pred = engine.predict(name, test_in)
    assert pred is not None and len(pred) == cfg.num_outputs, f'Model {name} prediction failed'
    opt = engine.prescriptive_optimization(name)
    assert opt['status'] in ('OPTIMAL', 'SUB-OPTIMAL (Overloaded)'), f'Optimization failed for {name}'

print(f'Successfully tested and validated all {len(engine.models)} ANN models with zero errors!')
